title: Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: We’re releasing a new class of reinforcement learning algorithms, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which perform comparably or better than state-of-the-art approaches while being much simpler to implement and tune. PPO has become the default reinforcement learning algorithm at OpenAI because of its ease of use and good performance.
body: We’re releasing a new class of reinforcement learning algorithms, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which perform comparably or better than state-of-the-art approaches while being much simpler to implement and tune. PPO has become the default reinforcement learning algorithm at OpenAI because of its ease of use and good performance.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了近端策略优化（PPO）算法，这是一种新型强化学习算法，旨在平衡算法性能、实现难度与调参复杂度。PPO在保持与现有最先进方法相当或更优性能的同时，显著简化了实现过程。由于其易用性和稳健的性能表现，PPO已成为OpenAI内部默认的强化学习算法。该算法通过限制策略更新的幅度，有效避免了训练过程中的剧烈波动，极大地提升了训练的稳定性，成为后续大模型对齐训练中不可或缺的技术基石。

aiReview.reasonZh: PPO算法是强化学习领域的里程碑，也是当前大模型训练中RLHF阶段的核心算法。

glossary.explanationZh: 近端策略优化，一种稳定且高效的强化学习算法。
策略优化，通过调整策略参数以最大化期望奖励的过程。
当前领域内最先进的技术水平。
